main.description: A streamplace node's report of view counts for one place.stream.video over a closed time window. Published in the reporting node's server repo (not the streamer's), so a video served by multiple nodes accumulates multiple records — consumers are expected to sum across trusted reporters. The rkey is conventionally `<windowStart-as-tid>-<video-rkey>` so re-running the aggregator over the same window is idempotent. Counts represent the reporting node's best effort given the data it has; the `tracks` array carries the objective byte / duration totals it observed.

video.description: AT-URI of the place.stream.video this count is for.

count.description: Number of distinct sessions the reporting node observed as a view over [windowStart, windowEnd).

windowStart.description: Inclusive lower bound of the aggregation window.

windowEnd.description: Exclusive upper bound of the aggregation window.

tracks.description: Per-track totals of bytes + playback duration the reporting node served over the window. Each entry references the place.stream.media.track record whose bytes were transferred, so user-contributed tracks (transcripts, transcodes published by other accounts) attribute naturally to their own records.

indexedAt.description: When the reporting node ran this aggregation. Useful for ordering successive reports.

trackUsage.description: One row of the tracks array: bytes + duration transferred for a single place.stream.media.track record over the window.

track.description: Strong reference to the place.stream.media.track record whose bytes were transferred.

bytes.description: Total bytes served from this track over the window. Sum across attributed segment_requests' Range intersections with the track's segment offsets in the metafile.

durationMs.description: Total playback duration served from this track, in milliseconds. Per HLS segment in the range: (overlap bytes / segment bytes) * segment duration, so partial-segment fetches credit a proportional share of duration.
